title: Wrong Design Intent Is Worse Than Never Conditioning: A Derangement-Control Diagnosis of Header Conditioning in CAD Program Completion
abstract: Fine-tuned code LLMs are routinely conditioned on a design-intent specification, but the correctness axis of such a signal -- a wrong intent rather than an absent one -- has not been tested, and the benefit of conditioning is usually scored with the same detector that defines the signal. We study CADCON, a five-feature design-intent header prepended to CadQuery-style programs during LoRA fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B, scoring adherence with executable geometric assertions that share no code with the header-defining extractor. On a pre-registered sample of 400 deduplicated held-out programs stratified over eleven intent profiles, at 40% prefix and three seeds, a semantically wrong header degrades adherence below the never-header-trained baseline on 3/3 seeds under both tokenizations at the program level, and on 3/3 token and 2/3 text seeds at the 298 distinct model inputs they present. Wrong-header executability is not depressed relative to that baseline. A derangement control, retrained so every program receives another program's header -- holding the header marginal fixed while destroying its correlation with the program -- saw the same programs, indices and wrong headers. Its correct-to-wrong change is -0.006/+0.016/-0.003 against 0.124/0.241/0.230 for the standard model, and the interaction is significant on 3/3 seeds (p <= 5.9e-7), so the model's sensitivity to whether the header is right or wrong requires the learned mapping. The control sits below the baseline by the same margin under a correct as under a wrong header, so we claim that sensitivity and not the below-baseline level. On features the true intent lacks, the standard model realizes a feature far more often when the wrong header names it; the control does not. Ground truth itself scores only 0.567 here, the scale on which arm levels should be read. Wrong design intent is not inert: it actively misdirects generation.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 arXiv 2607.23191v3 exact-version PDF 全文、文本抽取与页面渲染核验；代码状态按该版本 PDF 记录为 available（https://github.com/Jacky628/cadcon-derangement-control）。
analysis.ideaZh: CADCON v3 是实质更新：它把早期 38 unique-program clusters/76 entries 扩为预注册的 400 programs、298 distinct 40%-prefix inputs 与 11 intent profiles，并以 derangement-trained control 和执行级 geometry metric 复核“错误设计意图比无条件更糟”；多数 primary cells 和 Test-D interaction 仍成立，但 40% prefix、input clustering、extractor truncation 与 1.5B 单模型限制外推。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 它是 design-conditioned CAD agents 的 failure-mode 与 evaluation-instrument 研究，直接关系可控生成和安全回退。
analysis.evidenceZh: v3 在 400 个去重 programs、11 intent profiles 和 298 个 distinct 40%-prefix inputs 上执行预注册 replication。（Secs. 3.1-3.3 and Tables 1-2, pp. 8-10）；derangement control 接收同分布但内容不相关的 headers，用于区分机械输入异常与 learned semantic response。（Secs. 3.2-3.3 and Fig. 1, pp. 6-9）；作者报告 wrong-vs-none harm 在 program level 两种 tokenization 的 3/3 seeds 显著；distinct-input primary reading 中 6 cells 保留 5 cells，而 Test-D interaction 仍极显著。（Secs. 4.1-4.2 and Tables 3-5, pp. 18-22）
analysis.caveatZh: 作者限制：结论只覆盖 40% prefix conditional completion，不是 0% from-scratch generation。；作者限制：400 programs 只有 298 distinct inputs，首个 result assignment 的 extractor truncation 会丢掉后续几何阶段。；作者限制：仅验证 1.5B code LLM 和五类 proxy intent features，不能外推到自然语言工程规范。；审阅风险：执行级 target 仍由 regex 从 reference program 提取，target 本身并不等同真实 designer intent 或 manufacturability。
analysis.motivationZh: 论文把 design intent 编码成五类 CAD header，比较 correct、wrong、none 与 derangement-control 条件。核心不是追求最佳 CAD generator，而是诊断 conditional generator 是否语义性地响应错误信号：同样看到 byte-identical wrong headers 的 control 若不退化，就排除 rare-input mechanical effect。v3 进一步用程序执行后实体几何特征评分，并按 distinct inputs 重算 paired tests。
analysis.methodZh: 论文把 design intent 编码成五类 CAD header，比较 correct、wrong、none 与 derangement-control 条件。核心不是追求最佳 CAD generator，而是诊断 conditional generator 是否语义性地响应错误信号：同样看到 byte-identical wrong headers 的 control 若不退化，就排除 rare-input mechanical effect。v3 进一步用程序执行后实体几何特征评分，并按 distinct inputs 重算 paired tests。 科学贡献是把 derangement control 引入 design-conditioned program generation，并区分 signal adherence detector 与实际执行几何；v3 的扩大样本、预注册 protocol 与 cluster-aware reanalysis 对结论可信度有实质影响，不是版本戳变化。
analysis.experimentsZh: 用 Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B 对 CadQuery-style sketch-extrude programs 做 LoRA，比较正确、错误、无 header 及 derangement control；每个 condition 三 seeds，在 regex adherence 和执行 B-rep geometry 上做 paired tests、interaction 和 sensitivity analyses。 作者报告：作者报告 program-level wrong-vs-none 在 text/token 两侧均为 3/3 seeds 显著；按 298 distinct inputs 重算后 6 个 primary cells 中 5 个保留显著，Test-D interaction p 值仍约 10^-9 至 10^-10。（Tables 3-5, pp. 18-22; Sec. 6, p. 29） Baseline boundary：control design、三 seeds、执行级 metric 与多种 zero/truncation sensitivity 较强；但模型仅 1.5B、program family 较窄，尚无自然语言 designer intent 或工业 CAD tasks。 Ablation boundary：v3 增加 cluster-aware、executability、geometry scoring、profile weighting 与 zero-handling analyses；仍未重测 0% prefix，也未完成修复 extractor 后的独立预注册复验。
analysis.insightZh: 科学贡献是把 derangement control 引入 design-conditioned program generation，并区分 signal adherence detector 与实际执行几何；v3 的扩大样本、预注册 protocol 与 cluster-aware reanalysis 对结论可信度有实质影响，不是版本戳变化。 v3 相对 archived v2 有 material scientific delta，不能按无实质版本更新拒绝；建议精读其 control logic 与限制，并保留原 collectedAt、只作为版本更新事件处理。
